comment: Shadow tokens — box-shadow values for focus rings, elevation, and interactive states. All values in the semantic layer; no primitive shadows.

focus-ring.comment: Keyboard-focus ring on all interactive form controls. Appears on input, dropdown, pin, search, textarea, datepicker.

popover.comment: Floating panels — dropdowns, datepicker, search results list.

card.comment: Floating cards — toast notifications, carousel navigation buttons.

menu.comment: Context and action menus — slightly deeper than popover to visually separate from content.

thumb.comment: Draggable elements — range slider thumb, toggle pill thumb.
